# zlib 1.3.1

The compression library of CPU Test 3's ZLIB kernel, for the **Windows** build only: Android and iOS link the
system's zlib, Windows has none a program can link. The files deflate and inflate need, unchanged, from
https://github.com/madler/zlib/releases/download/v1.3.1/zlib-1.3.1.tar.gz
(SHA-256 9a93b2b7dfdac77ceba5a558a580e74667dd6fede4585b91eefb60f03b72df23). License: LICENSE (zlib).
